What do these columns mean?
Betthe side we like: O/U a win line, Yes/No otherwise
Marketthe market's chance for that side (its Kalshi price), with American odds
Modelour chance for that side, with fair odds
Edge¢model minus market after fees, in cents
eROIexpected return: edge ÷ the price paid
Best Betstight, well-traded books, 25%+ eROI, 3¢+ edge after fees; Liquid = the busiest books; Clear = every market, no filters
Take $ / +2¢ $dollars you could buy on the bet side at the listed price, and paying up to 2¢ more (from the order book, before fees)
Advanced viewthe book (Bid / Ask), the Take $ columns and the maker numbers - resting 1¢ inside the book, after its own (often lower) fee; blank where the book is too wide to rest in

Heisman projections · stats and Kalshi prices as of Sep 25, 6:39 PM CT · 57 candidates · 2% left for a winner outside this list
What is this?
Model our chance he wins the Heisman when ballots close (after the conference title games), from simulating the rest of the season and how Heisman voters have picked winners in the past, with its American odds. Part of the chance is left for a winner outside this list (the line above the table)
Blend our chance combined with the Kalshi price, with its American odds. One forecast among others, never a sure edge
Finalist his chance of being one of the 3 to 6 finalists invited to New York
Kalshi what a taker pays to buy YES right now - the ask plus Kalshi's fee - in cents and American odds (hover for bid / ask and the NO side)
Edge / eROI the better side for a taker now (YES or NO) at our Blend chance, after fees: the edge in cents and the expected return on the price paid
Team / Pwr / Rec click a team for its card; Pwr = its power rating (points better than an average FBS team on a neutral field) and its rank, Curr Rec = its record now, Proj Rec = its projected regular-season record (on a phone under the current one)
Rtg the Heisman Rating: our overall grade of his case at ballot time, 0-100 with 50 = the average candidate here. Tap a player for what goes into it
The stats right of Rtg, in the order the rating builds on them (More columns on a phone): touchdowns and yards projected over the full season - passing, rushing and receiving together, the split on hover - efficiency (passer rating for a quarterback, yards per touch for the rest), his team's projected losses and, of those, the ones against unranked teams. Tap a player for the rest (a top-4 team, power conference). Show current stats adds the same so far, and the rating and win chance if the season ended today
Colors green = better for his chances, red = worse (the power rating around 0, wins around 8.5, losses so far, the stats against the other candidates at his position; the chances only shade green); a positive edge shades green. Hover a column header for what it means
Tip click a player's row for his preview - his stats now and projected side by side; click a team for its card; click any column header to sort by it (again to reverse)
